about_the_game:
Discover Japan by train thanks to “Railroads of Japan” from Content Creator Ryuichi Kaminogi. This Content Creator Pack adds authentic Japanese railroad scenery to Cities: Skylines, including:

  • 4 Railroad Stations and 2 Railroad Trains
  • 6 Metro Stations and 1 Metro Train
  • 1 Bus and 1 Bus Depot
  • 4 Parks and 2 Ploppable buildings
  • 1 Unique Building and 1 Police Station
  • 13 props and 1 decorative network
